name: 10-multi-agency-coordination
description: A discharge that fans out into five parallel threads: home health nursing, DME delivery, wound supplies, a med course with a stop date, and a SNAP recertification the hospital knows nothing about. Every thread becomes a task; dropping any one is a major. This is the coordination load the workflow exists to carry.

input.document:
LAKESIDE REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER
DISCHARGE SUMMARY

Patient: WHITFIELD, DENISE A   DOB: 09/08/1951   MRN: LR-090441
Admission: 07/22/2026    Discharge: 07/27/2026
Attending: P. Nakamura, MD    Case Manager: B. Roth, LMSW

PRINCIPAL DIAGNOSIS: Diabetic foot ulcer, right heel (Wagner grade 2), with cellulitis — improving
SECONDARY: Type 2 DM, HTN, MDD

HOSPITAL COURSE:
74 y/o female admitted with an infected right heel ulcer. Wound debrided at bedside by podiatry; MRI negative for osteomyelitis. IV vancomycin narrowed to PO doxycycline per cultures. Vascular surgery consulted — adequate perfusion, no intervention. Wound care teaching begun but patient has limited ability to reach the wound; VNA referral placed. Depression screening: at baseline per patient; takes sertraline.

DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS:
1. Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID x 10 more days — NEW (last dose 08/06)
2. Insulin glargine 20 units SC nightly — continued
3. Metformin 1000 mg PO BID — continued
4. Lisinopril 20 mg PO daily — continued
5. Sertraline 100 mg PO daily — continued
6. Aspirin 81 mg PO daily — continued
7. Atorvastatin 40 mg PO nightly — continued
8. Hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg PO daily — continued

SERVICES ARRANGED:
- VNA of Long Island: skilled nursing 3x/week for wound care, first visit 07/29/2026 (referral #VNA-88213, confirmed).
- DME: knee walker + offloading boot ordered via MedEquip Plus, delivery expected 07/29-07/30 (order #ME-40771). Patient must be home to sign.
- Wound supplies: 30-day starter kit dispensed at discharge; ongoing supplies to be arranged by VNA nurse at first visit.

FOLLOW-UP:
1. Podiatry (Dr. Ganz, Lakeside Podiatry): 08/04/2026 1:30 PM — scheduled.
2. PCP Dr. Osei: within 2 weeks — patient to schedule.
3. Weekly wound measurements by VNA, faxed to podiatry.

WEIGHT-BEARING: Non-weight-bearing on right heel; use knee walker at all times indoors and out.

Discharged home. B. Roth LMSW coordinated services; contact 555-0163 with issues.
P. Nakamura, MD — 07/27/2026 12:10

mustNot: drop any of the five service threads — each is a separate task with a separate owner and date
miss that the DME delivery requires the member home to sign while VNA starts the same window — the collision is the coordination insight
lose the SNAP recertification thread just because the hospital document never mentions it — whole-member context includes the open SDOH facts
address the member as anything but Miss Dee in task text
